cards.name: Gut, Bestial Fanatic
cards.oracleText: When this creature specializes, create a token that's a copy of a creature card exiled with this creature, except it's 5/5 and has trample and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.

cards.name: Gut, Brutal Fanatic
cards.oracleText: When this creature specializes, create a token that's a copy of a creature card exiled with this creature, except it's 4/4 and has menace and haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
